links.outcome: DeepSLE performance across gender, age, ethnicity, and socioeconomic subgroups
links.effect: Robust performance reported across subgroups stratified by gender, age, ethnicity, and socioeconomic status; overall AUCs of 0.822-0.969 for SLE in multi-ethnic validation datasets.
links.quote: Additionally, DeepSLE demonstrates robust performance across subgroups stratified by gender, age, ethnicity, and socioeconomic status.

screen.reason: Evaluates a deep learning system (DeepSLE) for detecting systemic lupus erythematosus from retinal images, including subgroup equity analyses, explainability evaluations, and a reader study comparing model performance against primary care physicians.
